newsitem.title: CHINA: China to crack down on "prison overlords".
newsitem.headline: China to crack down on "prison overlords".

text.p: China has called for a crackdown on crooked prison officials who abuse their positions to shorten sentences and who act as virtual lords in their domains, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

Legal authorities should "strictly investigate criminal cases of prison officials using official powers to demand or take bribes...and strike out at 'prison overlords'," Xinhua quoted Procurator General Zhang Siqing as saying.
Prison inspection departments across China had revealed 5,214 cases of official abuses by prison officials and police from 1988 to June 1996, Xinhua said.
Offences included trading reduced sentences, early paroles or medical releases for cash or gifts, the agency said.
China passed a law in 1994 to stop abuses by jailers and prison guards by standardising penalties and prohibiting mistreatment of prisoners.
